definitions.explanation: The area or structure into which a ball must be sent to score, or the act of scoring.
The end point of a race or journey.
An aim or desired result that one works toward.

⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゴール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。

examples.english: It is good to set your final goal and then work toward it by setting small targets one at a time.

notes:
ゴール is a loanword from English "goal" used across three contexts: sports scoring, finish lines, and objectives.

SPORTS:
- ゴール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to score a goal
- ゴール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go into the goal
- ⟦ゴールキーパー→ゴールキーパー：06585_goorukiipaa⟧: goalkeeper
- ⟦ゴールネット→ゴールネット：noentry⟧: goal net

FINISH LINE:
- ゴール⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reach the finish line (used as a suru verb)
- ⟦ゴールイン→ゴールイン：noentry⟧: reaching the goal/finish line

OBJECTIVE:
- ゴール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for a goal
- ゴール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set a goal
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧ゴール: final/ultimate goal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: target, objective (more formal, emphasizes a concrete measurable aim)
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: purpose, objective (emphasizes the reason or purpose behind an action)

NOTE:
⟦ゴールイン→ゴールイン：noentry⟧ can also colloquially mean "getting married" — reaching the "finish line" of a relationship.
